record.title: Stale-proof refresh queue
record.description: Turn stale-proof classifications into a deterministic, reviewable refresh queue without granting provider or registry mutation authority.

content.summary: Turn stale-proof classifications into a deterministic, reviewable refresh queue without granting provider or registry mutation authority.
content.objective: Turn stale-proof classifications into a deterministic, reviewable refresh queue without granting provider or registry mutation authority.
acceptance_criteria: Queue entries use stable project-scoped identities and source evidence references.
Repeated generation from unchanged inputs produces identical queue ordering and content.
Queue entries distinguish observation work from any later mutation request.
Foundation verification covers empty, current-proof, stale-proof, and conflicting-proof inputs.

record.title: Direct provider read adapters
record.description: Add receipt-backed read-only GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase observation adapters while retaining file input as a supported fallback.

content.summary: Add receipt-backed read-only GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase observation adapters while retaining file input as a supported fallback.
content.objective: Add receipt-backed read-only GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase observation adapters while retaining file input as a supported fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Every adapter is read-only and records provider, scope, observation time, and evidence identity.
No credential value, cookie, token, or environment value is persisted in Foundation artifacts.
Unavailable or denied provider surfaces remain explicit rather than inferred.
File-based observation input remains supported and contract-compatible.

record.title: Deterministic roadmap next command
record.description: Expose the stable machine roadmap through a read-only human and JSON next-work command.

content.summary: Expose the stable machine roadmap through a read-only human and JSON next-work command.
content.objective: Expose the stable machine roadmap through a read-only human and JSON next-work command.
acceptance_criteria: foundation roadmap next reads only FOUNDATION_ROADMAP.json.
Completed work is excluded unless explicitly requested.
Human and JSON output preserve IDs, lifecycle, dependencies, unknown priority, and source revision.
Repeated reads from unchanged input produce identical ordering.

record.title: Cross-app privacy and data contracts
record.description: Define reusable privacy-first data boundaries for Fitness, wellness, Mazer, Trove, and future applications.

content.summary: Define reusable privacy-first data boundaries for Fitness, wellness, Mazer, Trove, and future applications.
content.objective: Define reusable privacy-first data boundaries for Fitness, wellness, Mazer, Trove, and future applications.
acceptance_criteria: Versioned contracts cover profile, consent, sensitive data, retention, deletion, ownership, sharing, and audit receipts.
Product-specific extensions cannot weaken shared privacy semantics.
Fixtures and verification cover allowed, denied, unknown, and revoked states.

record.title: Foundation product operating layer
record.description: Finish Foundation as the trusted operator dashboard for project health, data posture, deployment proof, and safe next actions.

content.summary: Finish Foundation as the trusted operator dashboard for project health, data posture, deployment proof, and safe next actions.
content.objective: Finish Foundation as the trusted operator dashboard for project health, data posture, deployment proof, and safe next actions.
acceptance_criteria: Registry, proof, deployment, data, Playbook, and Lifeline projections are current and source-linked.
The console explains blockers and recommended next actions without claiming owner authority.
Operator routing preserves approval and production deployment gates.
A complete local verification and browser proof cover the operator workflow.

record.title: Foundation control-plane truth reconciliation
record.description: Reconcile the canonical Foundation GitHub identity and current remote evidence across config, registry, generated surfaces, fixtures, setup docs, and Atlas projection.

content.summary: Reconcile the canonical Foundation GitHub identity and current remote evidence across config, registry, generated surfaces, fixtures, setup docs, and Atlas projection.
content.objective: Reconcile the canonical Foundation GitHub identity and current remote evidence across config, registry, generated surfaces, fixtures, setup docs, and Atlas projection.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical GitHub repository identity is verified from live remote evidence.
Foundation config, data/projects.json, generated docs, console data, fixtures, and setup guidance agree on that identity.
Historical promotion evidence remains immutable and clearly dated.
Foundation build and verify pass, and Atlas root projection is refreshed separately.
